title: The Bulletproof Glass Effect: Unintended Consequences of Privacy Notices
eligible_reason: No difference-in-differences or event-study design. Content analysis, manager survey, one field study and five online experiments.
design_notes: Seven studies: content analysis of privacy notices, manager survey, a field study and online experiments comparing privacy-notice conditions. No panel, no staggered adoption.
